summary: BizBuzz 2026 ran two six-week camps side by side — KidPreneur Camp and Venture Lab — alongside the Fish Tank competition and the Naperville Children's Business Fair, reaching 365 students.

programs.title: 2026 Summer Entrepreneurship Camp
programs.description: Two six-week programs running simultaneously — KidPreneur Camp and Venture Lab — from June 5 to July 10, covering ideation, finance, marketing and prototyping, business models, presentation skills, and a mock pitch.

timeline.label: 2026 Summer Camps Begin

timeline.label: Final Camp Session
